content.text: {"claims":[{"claim":1,"text":"Contrastive self-supervised learning frameworks for tabular sensor data can improve anomaly detection performance by encoding irregular temporal sampling and elapsed-time information into feature representations.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-08881","field":"abstract","quote":"time-aware contrastive objective in which the target similarity between an anchor and a candidate positive is modulated by the elapsed time"},{"id":"SYN-PUB-08885","field":"abstract","quote":"time-gap encoding that injects elapsed-time information into a shallow transformer"}]},{"claim":2,"text":"Unsupervised learning methods for industrial SCADA and sensor data have been validated on multi-month production records from manufacturing facilities and utilities without requiring supervised annotations.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-08878","field":"abstract","quote":"six months of data from a food-processing line and eight months from a plastics extrusion facility"},{"id":"SYN-PUB-08885","field":"abstract","quote":"seven datasets from manufacturing and utilities sectors"}]}]}
